source: Independent assertions against actual ColorConverter + ShareResult. Author hook/DOM/clipboard fixture reused; no native-browser claim.

results.name: original shorthand and invalid draft failures retain all five exact representations
alpha, CSS, Unicode and long drafts never truncate into valid RGB or rewrite URL
failed native and legacy copy is honest; manual focus reentry cannot restore stale output
input and locale ABA prevent stale fallback and copied status
share image and direct copy invalidate each other without late downloads
initial URL canonicalizes only owned color and preserves unrelated duplicate query/hash/state
early edit beats hydration; duplicate color URL does not silently choose a value
random includes both endpoints and unmount blocks pending completion
